coverage_warning: 18,233 / 20,084 records (90.8%) are Cox's Bazar. Dhaka district only 3; Khulna district 66; not national completeness. No records have clean_adm3 Dacope. Basic has 70,894 country rows but same latest assessment (2019-11-21), zero Dacope-labelled rows. The bounded Dacope-nearby box (22.35–22.7 N, 89.3–89.7 E) contains 55 Basic vs 39 Plus rows, but Basic box records are labelled Koyra/Paikgachha, not Dacope.
ui_rules: Label layer Historical water-point candidates (2014–2019); every point Current availability unknown / Drinking-water safety unknown.
Show exact assessment date, provider, administrative labels, source/technology, WPdx ID and inventory link for each point.
Default must not label status_id Yes, improved technology, old subjective quality or old coliform absence as safe or currently open.
Keep inventory map colours neutral (blue/grey), separate from polluted river screen colours.
Do not rank distant inventory points as practical sources: show straight-line distance, limited coverage, radius filter, and no verified nearby source if none.
External navigation is only to coordinates and cannot assure flood-safe, accessible or operating route.
Do not use status_clean as an up-to-date availability rule; retain raw for audit with source presence/status caveat.
Do not infer exposure from simple circular distance or infer that nearby groundwater is chemically polluted from river proximity.
Require current operator/local-authority confirmation and fit-for-purpose water tests before any safe label.
privacy: Browser subset has no contact names, phone numbers, emails, photo links or free-text notes. Named providers are organisations. Public inventory coordinates retained; no private datasets used.

download_caveat: Direct urllib downloads of waterpointdata.org website/PDF returned HTML JavaScript challenges. Those responses were labelled blocked-*.html and are not valid source PDF snapshots. Official licence and data standard content were verified through the web tool. Socrata API responses are real parsed CSV/JSON.
